findings.evidence: `HilbertBasis.lean:65-66`: "G. Szegő, *Orthogonal Polynomials* … chapter IV, §4.7 and §3.1."; the pre-existing `Measure.lean:63-64` citation is "chapter IV, §4.7" only, so the §3.1 pointer is new in this diff.

findings.issue: The informal source reads "chapter IV, §4.7 and §3.1", placing §3.1 in chapter IV. Szegő numbers sections chapter-first (§4.7 is in chapter IV), so §3.1 — the general-theory section cited for the completeness half — is in chapter III; the pointer sends a reader to the wrong chapter.
